$comment: This is a DECLARED control artifact, not documentation: every value below is
read by integrations/paperclip/reporting/policy.py and used by composer.py and
model.py. A rule stated here and ignored by the code would be a decoration, so
the composer holds no second copy of any rule below. Editing this file changes
the composer's behaviour, which is what makes it a control.

resolution.$comment: What makes a brief line resolvable. A brief line is a claim, never prose.

unresolved.produces: a finding that names the line, never prose
unresolved.subject: the claim's own subject (the module id, or the section it belongs to)
unresolved.detail: the refusal is emitted for every claim that cites nothing, or cites something that resolves neither to a registry row nor to a path under either declared base

resolution.$note: a citation resolves when it is the registry prefix plus a row of the registry document this brief was composed from, or when it is a path that exists under one of the declared bases

pending.$comment: The rule that keeps a declared target honest: pending is never rendered as shipped.
pending.when: a declared target that has no vendor module.json in the pinned hub catalog at this revision
pending.blocker_detail: a pending module must name the blocking hub issue(s) that keep it pending — an unnamed blocker is indistinguishable from a wish
